ModMetaData.name: Rim Languages - Late Factions
ModMetaData.author: portimeow
ModMetaData.description: Compatibility patch for Cybranian - Rim Languages. Factions created after world generation (Hegemony splinters, mid-save mod factions, quest factions) never get a dialect, which the base mod doesn't support. This assigns one on load and whenever such a faction appears: splinters and expeditions inherit the dialect of the faction whose name they contain, others take a same-def faction's dialect, and anything left gets a new dialect.
